falsifier: no-to-the-rest settles fewer units or completes fewer findings than group-question in any cell, at any budget or share of yes answers
hypothesis: one choice that answers no to every capability question left, with each capability question at its place, settles more ASVS units per choice and costs STRIDE nothing
intervention: run.py early-policies over 186 STRIDE and 32 ASVS archived reports, with the no-to-the-rest policies at yes shares of none, a third and all. No cell loses to group-question. At a third: ASVS alone 924 units at 5 choices (780 before), whole ASVS list 364 choices (790); with both frameworks STRIDE 2,027 at 5 (2,027). A box at the first capability's place cost STRIDE 832 at 5; a box at the last place cost ASVS 80 units at 10 (768).
reconsider_when: a measurement of how often an owner answers no to a capability the application has
scope: the walk answers truthfully and counts dependency sets, so a wrong no and the owner's reading of the page are not measured
signature: an ASVS job asks a capability question for every capability no answer states
